journeys.name: Add a New Training Provider
journeys.description: An admin searches for a provider by UKPRN, supplies and reviews details, selects provider configurations, and adds the provider.

journeys.name: Add a Provider and Mark as Supporting
journeys.description: Admins add a provider, select 'Supporting' type, and skip the additional configuration steps.

journeys.name: Restrict an Approved Course
journeys.description: An admin searches for an unrestricted course, chooses to restrict it, and confirms the restriction.

journeys.name: Add a Provider to a Restricted Course
journeys.description: An admin selects a restricted course and adds a provider to its delivery list.

journeys.name: Change Provider Restriction or Delivery Dates for a Course
journeys.description: An admin changes restriction settings or delivery dates for a course at a provider.

journeys.name: Remove a Restricted Course from a Provider
journeys.description: An admin removes a restricted course from a provider's allowed list.

journeys.name: Manage a Training Provider
journeys.description: An admin accesses a provider via search, then manages all aspects of that provider from a hub page.

journeys.name: Update Provider Status (including Removal)
journeys.description: An admin changes a provider's status, with a conditional removal path if needed.

journeys.name: Restrict a Provider
journeys.description: An admin restricts a provider so they may deliver only approved courses.

journeys.name: Manage a Provider’s Restricted Apprenticeships
journeys.description: An admin views a provider’s restricted courses and adds or updates restrictions as needed.

journeys.name: Add a Restricted Course to a Provider
journeys.description: Adds a restricted course for a provider including setting special dates or confirming as needed.

journeys.name: Add a Restricted Course Last Start Date for Provider
journeys.description: Sets a last start date for a specific restricted course and provider.

journeys.name: Change a Provider's Organisation or Route Type
journeys.description: Provides the workflow for updating the organisation or delivery type for a provider.

journeys.name: Update Provider Apprenticeship Offering
journeys.description: Update if a provider offers apprenticeships and their units.

journeys.name: Browse and Manage Restricted Courses
journeys.description: An admin browses all restricted courses and manages restrictions for each.
